title: HELIX Bridge: Handshake Experiences → ExperientialLearning

source_objects.description: A student-submitted internship, co-op, or similar experience, approved by career services and sometimes by faculty for credit.
Approval steps, supervisor evaluation, and student reflection, where the school uses them.

notes: Handshake carries the institutional student ID from SSO or the student data feed. Resolve that ID to HELIX Student in the restricted identity zone; never match on name and email alone without steward review. Merge with the ERP registration in silver when the experience is for credit (same student, term, and course). The ERP row owns credit and grade; this row owns employer, supervisor, pay, hours, and evaluation.
validate: Field labels follow a typical Handshake Experiences export and vary by school configuration. VALIDATE against your export. Symplicity and 12twenty carry the same fields.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from the Experience ID.
Internship -> internship, Co-op -> co_op, Practicum -> practicum, Research -> undergraduate_research, Externship -> externship, Apprenticeship -> apprenticeship, Service -> service_learning.
Third-party PII. Don't publish or share outside career services.
Total hours, or hours per week times weeks if only a weekly figure is captured.
Decimal. The ERP registration wins if the two disagree.
Resolve to HELIX Course or CourseSection.
Store with the unit in your documentation (hourly vs total). Confidential.
true for NSSE high-impact practice types.
